name: fortrabbit

evidence.paas: 03: managed PHP application hosting; fortrabbit runs the components and the customer deploys the code

line: Host PHP applications on managed cloud infrastructure.

free.text: 7-day per-app trial; app/data deleted at end without payment

work.math: €1 for PHP + €0.50 for storage + €10 for traffic + €0.50 for backup. Assumes up to 512 MiB of storage and total traffic up to 128 GiB.
€23 a month host subtotal (PHP €12 + storage €0.50 + traffic €10 + backup €0.50). It has 1 GiB of RAM, but the 1 vCPU allocation is not documented.
€23 for the host + $42.19 for Neon compute and storage + backup at $0.09 per unit + history at $0.20 per unit, with the number of units unknown. Whether the host's vCPU fits is not verified.
